dataSource: Archived Webull D 90 names batches 1-5 and earlier frozen 283 event list; T daily as-of sector/20-day true range nearest-match control, no pay data
question: Did next-day-open entry ever experience +3% RTH high in first 20 FULL trading sessions, ignoring deep losses/stops; and is this occurrence different from sector+priorATR matched same-day non-shock peers?
methods: For each event, choose single same-sector non-shock (day return>-7%), smallest absolute difference in past20 average true range as pct of prior close (no future features). Restrict paired to 275/283; 8 semiconductor shocks April 3 2025 had NO same-sector non-shock peer. The close-high threshold is an excursion not trade PnL; no call option delta/time/spread. Since constructed after outcomes were already examined, diagnostic not preregistered strategy proof.
